description: This file handles migration and configuration logic for integrating Claude CLI authentication within the openclaw plugin SDK, including model reference conversions, configuration patch creation, and migration notes.

methods.name: toClaudeCliModelRef
methods.description: Converts a raw string to a Claude CLI model reference if it matches the expected format.

methods.name: rewriteModelSelection
methods.description: Rewrites a given model configuration to use Claude CLI references where applicable, indicating if changes were made.

methods.name: rewriteModelEntryMap
methods.description: Migrates model entries in a map to Claude CLI references, returning the migrated map and list of migrated keys.

methods.name: hasClaudeCliAuth
methods.description: Checks if Claude CLI credentials are cached, indicating available authentication.

methods.name: buildAnthropicCliMigrationResult
methods.description: Builds a migration result object for integrating Claude CLI auth into the configuration, including notes and config patches.
